title: File the XI.11 plane-rotation bug upstream (from Nelson's #155 comment)
description: Rotating the plane at the lower-left corner of propXI11 slides points along the plane instead of preserving relationships: F between G and H ends with G between F and H. Nelson described it with two screenshots in his #155 comment. Offered to file it; wait for his nod, then file with his screenshots and a reproduction on euclids-elements.org.
acceptance_criteria: Issue exists on brownnrl/euclid with reproduction steps, his screenshots, and a pointer to the relevant plane/rotate code path.

title: Book IV deck planning tables (16 props) — draft per process.md, do not implement
description: Prepare planning tables for IV.1–IV.16 following euclids-elements-lektor/doc/process.md. Tables are reviewed by Nelson BEFORE implementation. Author in the plain-data discipline (string animation names, no concat, no functions in slides[]). Blocked on his answer to the #155 question for the format; the table drafting itself can proceed.

title: Audit doc/code discrepancies in geomlib found by research; open one upstream PR
description: docs/research/geomlib-internals.md lists: _elementsForUpdate in architecture.md does not exist; animationConfig.rates never read; api.md:901 keys config by enum vs code by string; reducedMotion ignores prefers-reduced-motion; title required but unused; width/height undocumented. Verify each against current upstream main, then fix the doc-only ones in one PR. Code-behaviour ones become separate issues.
acceptance_criteria: Each claim re-verified with file:line at upstream HEAD. One doc PR opened. Any behavioural discrepancy filed as an upstream issue, not fixed silently.
